Taur-ahe (pronounced "taur-AH-heh"), often written without the hyphen, is the language of the tauren. It is at least partially written using pictograms. There are many different forms and dialects of Taur-ahe, all differing based on tribe and location.

The tauren have a long history, much of which is recorded on banners hanging in the tent of the Archdruid on Thunder Bluff. These various myths recount important events from the history of the people, and illustrate the virtues they hold to be important. Sun rocs feature prominently in primitive tauren mythological cycles. A more elaborate version of the early myths is told in the short story "Eyes of the Earth Mother".

The mighty tauren warriors of the Kalimdor plains have pledged their allegiance to the new Horde out of respect for their courage and honor. The bold tauren seek only to safeguard their quiet culture from the deathly fires of the Burning Legion. When roused, tauren are fierce fighters and use their mighty totems to smash their enemies into the dust of the plains. Tauren warriors can pulverize enemies by smashing their totems on the ground, creating tremendous shockwaves that ripple out and cause damage in a wide area of effect.

The Tavern of Time (or Taverns of Time) is a small tavern located near the start of the Timeless Tunnel leading down into the Caverns of Time. It is run by the drink vendor Alexston Chrome. Alexston and a Dancing Flame are seen dancing, while a Tavern Bouncer guards the entrance in front of a line of Queuing Revelers.

Taurajo Refugees are tauren displaced from Camp Taurajo. They escaped the Alliance's attack on the camp, later moving to Camp Una'fe. Several were attacked and killed by the hostile plants in the Overgrowth while out hunting for berries and nuts. Others were captured by quilboar while fleeing Taurajo. They can be found being flailed about by Grasping Overgrowths, held in quilboar cages, or resting in Camp Una'fe.

Team 2, or the World of Warcraft Development Team, is one of the design teams of Blizzard Entertainment, in charge of World of Warcraft. As of November 2018, it consists of between 100–300 individuals.

Taurajo Looters are humans found in the Southern Barrens, picking over the Ruins of Taurajo. They were originally sent to the Southern Barrens as a penal legion from the Stormwind Stockade, a part of the Northwatch Expeditionary Force soldiers under the command of General John Hawthorne. While some of them were apprehended by Alliance adventurers at General Hawthorne's behest and sent to the brig, others were not so lucky. Those found by Horde adventurers under the command of Warlord Bloodhilt were killed and strung up along the Gold Road as a warning to the Alliance.

The Tavern is a neutral building in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne where mercenary heroes can be bought. These buildings are never guarded by creeps (outside of custom maps) and generally found near the player's starting position. In addition to buying mercenary heroes, the Tavern can also revive your heroes immediately without having to wait. This allows them to rejoin the fray faster, but doing so is ill advised unless the resources can be spared. The cost of this instant revive is 80% of the hero's gold & lumber cost at level 1, +20% per level, up to a maximum of 1400350. Along with the increased cost to instantly revive a hero, heroes revived this way also start with 50% of their health

Many of them can be seen carrying sacks of apples from the orchard and offloading them at wagons or crates in the nearby town. As revealed in dialogue with the Tarren Mill Horsehand, one of the peasants is named Benjamin, while another working on a broken wagon on the east side of the orchard is named Samuel.

Tauren Earthshakers are tauren located at the Dranosh'ar Blockade alongside other Horde soldiers shortly before the Burning of Teldrassil. Other earthshakers are seen running from Orgrimmar's gates to report to Holgar Stormaxe, then continuing to the end of the Blockade to report to the Horde Warbringer who sort them into divisions that stand in front of Skull Rock. They later arrived to the Blackwood Den in Darkshore once the Horde had captured it. During the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, they stood with Varok Saurfang's rebellion at the Blockade.

Tauralus milk is widely sold by inkeepers in Maldraxxus. The Maldraxxi army use them as mounts. Dundae is a tauralus wrangler.
Taskmaster Matyas is a venthyr located at Witherfall Ruin in Revendreth.
The Taste of Zandalar is an open kitchen located at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
Tea Tales is a quest achievement earned by hearing every side of the story at Theotar's tea party.
Taskmaster Gavril is a venthyr located in the Sinposium in Revendreth.
Tattered Map can be mined from Platinum Deposit and Rich Platinum Deposit.
Tasty T-Bone drops from Skyrange Mushans in Skyrange in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Te'zan is a wolf :soulshape located in Ardenweald. He is a helpful soul and close friends with Niya, helping to protect the souls and wildseeds in the Shrouded Mire. He is initially seen asking for help when a caravan of souls is attacked by Starving Shadowstalkers. Te'zan worked with spirits during his entire mortal life and always wished he could be a wolf "ALL the time" (as opposed to only some of the time), hinting that he was a shaman.
Tayo was the former lieutenant and bodyguard of Apari and the current Zandalari Empire ambassador to the Horde. She is tall and has black hair.
Taste of Victory is a quest reward from the main Faction Assaults quests for low-level players instead of the actual reward.
Tavian is a venthyr innkeeper located in Sinfall in Revendreth.
Tasty Toes are looted from Halis's Lunch Pail in the House of Constructs in Maldraxxus.
The Tattered Binding drops from the Unleashed Major Hex in the Grove of Memory in Ardenweald.
Tea Bones are sold by innkeepers and food vendors in Maldraxxus.
The Tasty Bone is provided for Give A Dog A Bone. Throw it at a group of Marrowgrub Nibblers to entice Dog Bone to eat them, spawning a Giant Marrowgrub.

Two Tarren Mill Horses can be found in the stables south of Tarren Mill in Old Hillsbrad Foothills, alongside Young Blanchy. One of the horses, referred to as Old Bessy in dialogue, is regularly fed apples and taken on walks by the Tarren Mill Horsehand, eliciting jealousy from Blanchy. __NOTOC__
The sinstone of Tazerath of Seven Seas of Sand is found at the Decimated Crossroad in Revendreth.
Tauralus mounts were first added to World of Warcraft with Shadowlands.
__NOTOC__ Tash'irel's Edict is located in Nor'Danil Wellspring in Azsuna.
Tasteful Tiara drops from the first Kunzen hozen kill in the Valley of the Four Winds after gaining Buddy with Tina Mudclaw.

Tazavesh, the Veiled Market an eight-boss Mythic megadungeon set in a bazaar of the mysterious brokers, facing off against dastardly assassins, four-armed broker guards, an infinite dragon pirate, and other enemies as a wayward broker is chased down before she can unleash the might of a stolen artifact to realize her own designs. The elusive market is situated in the In-Between and changes location on a whim. Tazavesh has a (small) open world area outside the dungeon, the Docks, which contains a few generic non-interactive NPCs.
__NOTOC__ Taskmaster Askari is an orc located in the Motherlode.

Tea for the Troubled is awarded to players who serve tea to eight characters while controlling Tubbins during A Tea for Every Occasion in the Venthyr Assault on the Tremaculum. Only four characters will be visible each day, so consider not turning in the quest immediately and returning on a later date during the assault to find more characters.
Taskmaster Xox is an abomination located in Akarek's Tears in Maldraxxus. He appears after killing Taskmaster Joyless, Taskmaster Mortis, or Taskmaster Bloata.
Taskmaster's Tenderizer drops from Taskmaster Xox in Akarek's Tears in Maldraxxus.
Taskmaster Joyless is an abomination located in Akarek's Tears in Maldraxxus.
Taskmaster Mortis is an abomination located in Akarek's Tears in Maldraxxus.
Taskmaster Bloata is an abomination located in Akarek's Tears in Maldraxxus.

]] Tasty Mawshroom can be fed to Darkmaul west of the Mauler's Outlook in northwestern Korthia. Find them in Invasive Mawshrooms, found throughout the zone. Feed enough Mawshrooms to Darkmaul to earn the Darkmaul (item) mount.

Tattered Fae Designs can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 150 Cataloged Research and 75 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
Taruka, later called Taruka Beastkiller, is a young tuskarr fisher and the titular protagonist of the short story "One Small Tuskarr".
Tazavesh Gearglider is awarded for earning the Fake It 'Til You Make It achievement, by completing Tazavesh, the Veiled Market in hard mode.
This quest can only be accepted while wearing the Passably-Forged Credentials.
Tarratus Keystone drops from Portal Keeper Hasabel in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Tattered Scraps of Clothing are a world drop, dropping from ash ghouls.
Taurajo Intelligence is found at the Ruins of Taurajo in the Southern Barrens.
Tattered Scornful Leggings drop from Thrashbite the Scornful in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Taunka Boots are a world drop and are looted from Cache of Eregos.
Taskmaster's Key dropped from Taskmaster Burlok at Saltstone Mine in Stormsong Valley.
Taskmaster's Trove is found at the Feeders' Thicket in Revendreth. Interact with the Ingress and Egress Rites, avoid the floating orbs, and loot the trove before you get bumped away!
The Teachings of the Elders are looted from the Stolen Scroll in Zereth Mortis.
Taskmaster Xy'pro is a broker located in Ephemeral Plains in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Tassets of Densified Ooze drop from Decatriarch Wratheye in Brackenhide Hollow.
__NOTOC__ Tazenrath is a proto-dragon located in the Burrow of the Faithful in the Forbidden Reach. Several Awakening Tarasek are found kneeling nearby.
